mapper.select: SELECT s.store_id, YEAR(s.business_date) * 100 + MONTH(s.business_date) AS ym, SUM(CASE WHEN s.kind = 'SALE' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * i.final_amount * 100 / (100 + i.tax_rate)) AS amount FROM pos_sale s JOIN pos_sale_item i ON i.sale_id = s.id WHERE s.status = 'COMPLETED' AND s.business_date >= #{begin} AND s.business_date <= #{end} GROUP BY s.store_id, YEAR(s.business_date) * 100 + MONTH(s.business_date)

SELECT s.store_id, YEAR(s.business_date) * 100 + MONTH(s.business_date) AS ym, -SUM(f.cost_amount) AS amount FROM pos_sale s JOIN wms_stock_flow f ON f.doc_id = s.wms_doc_id AND f.biz_type IN ('IN', 'OUT') WHERE s.status = 'COMPLETED' AND f.cost_amount IS NOT NULL AND s.business_date >= #{begin} AND s.business_date <= #{end} GROUP BY s.store_id, YEAR(s.business_date) * 100 + MONTH(s.business_date)

SELECT w.store_id, YEAR(d.biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(d.biz_date) AS ym, SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN d.total_amount - d.tax_amount ELSE d.tax_amount - d.total_amount END) AS amount FROM scm_trade_doc d JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = d.warehouse_id WHERE d.kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND d.biz_date >= #{begin} AND d.biz_date <= #{end} GROUP BY w.store_id, YEAR(d.biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(d.biz_date)

SELECT w.store_id, YEAR(d.biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(d.biz_date) AS ym, -SUM(f.cost_amount) AS amount FROM wms_stock_flow f JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.wms_doc_id = f.doc_id JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = f.warehouse_id WHERE f.biz_type IN ('IN', 'OUT') AND f.cost_amount IS NOT NULL AND d.kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND d.biz_date >= #{begin} AND d.biz_date <= #{end} GROUP BY w.store_id, YEAR(d.biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(d.biz_date)

SELECT l.from_store_id AS store_id, YEAR(l.biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(l.biz_date) AS ym, SUM(l.amount - COALESCE(l.cost_amount, 0)) AS amount FROM dist_store_ledger l WHERE l.biz_date >= #{begin} AND l.biz_date <= #{end} GROUP BY l.from_store_id, YEAR(l.biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(l.biz_date)

SELECT l.to_store_id AS store_id, YEAR(l.biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(l.biz_date) AS ym, SUM(l.amount - COALESCE(l.cost_amount, 0)) AS amount FROM dist_store_ledger l WHERE l.biz_date >= #{begin} AND l.biz_date <= #{end} GROUP BY l.to_store_id, YEAR(l.biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(l.biz_date)

SELECT COALESCE(a.store_id, #{hqId}) AS store_id, YEAR(d.doc_date) * 100 + MONTH(d.doc_date) AS ym, SUM(d.amount) AS amount FROM fin_io_doc d JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = d.account_id WHERE GROUP BY COALESCE(a.store_id, #{hqId}), YEAR(d.doc_date) * 100 + MONTH(d.doc_date)

SELECT i.category_id, c.name AS category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS doc_count, SUM(i.amount) AS amount FROM fin_io_doc d JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = d.account_id JOIN fin_io_doc_item i ON i.doc_id = d.id LEFT JOIN fin_io_category c ON c.id = i.category_id WHERE AND COALESCE(a.store_id, #{hqId}) = #{storeId} GROUP BY i.category_id, c.name ORDER BY SUM(i.amount) DESC
SELECT r.store_id, r.period AS ym_text, SUM(r.amount) AS amount FROM chain_alloc_record r WHERE r.period >= #{beginPeriod} AND r.period <= #{endPeriod} GROUP BY r.store_id, r.period
SELECT u.store_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sys_user u WHERE u.status = 1 AND u.store_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.store_id

SELECT g.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, w.store_id, g.material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, g.sold_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) FROM wms_stock s WHERE s.warehouse_id = g.warehouse_id AND s.material_id = g.material_id) AS stock_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ti.qty), 0) FROM wms_stock_doc_item ti JOIN wms_stock_doc td ON td.id = ti.doc_id WHERE td.kind = 'TRANSFER' AND td.status = 'TRANSIT' AND td.to_warehouse_id = g.warehouse_id AND ti.material_id = g.material_id) AS transit_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL') THEN COALESCE(ri.approved_qty, 0) - ri.delivered_qty ELSE ri.qty END), 0) FROM dist_requisition_item ri JOIN dist_requisition r ON r.id = ri.requisition_id WHERE r.warehouse_id = g.warehouse_id AND ri.material_id = g.material_id AND r.status IN ('DRAFT', 'APPROVING', 'SUBMITTED', 'APPROVED', 'PARTIAL')) AS requisition_qty FROM (SELECT f.warehouse_id, f.material_id, -SUM(f.qty) AS sold_qty FROM wms_stock_flow f JOIN wms_stock_doc d ON d.id = f.doc_id AND d.kind = f.biz_type WHERE f.warehouse_id IN #{wid} AND ((d.kind = 'OUT' AND d.biz_type IN ('SALES', 'RETAIL')) OR (d.kind = 'IN' AND d.biz_type IN ('SALES_RETURN', 'RETAIL_RETURN'))) AND d.biz_date >= #{begin} AND d.biz_date <= #{end} GROUP BY f.warehouse_id, f.material_id) g JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = g.warehouse_id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = g.material_id WHERE g.sold_qty > 0
AND (m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY g.warehouse_id, m.code

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.kind = 'SALE' THEN s.payable_amount ELSE -s.payable_amount END), 0) AS sales, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.kind = 'SALE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS orders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.kind = 'SALE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), 0) AS returns, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN x.kind = 'SALE' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * i.final_amount * 100 / (100 + i.tax_rate)) FROM pos_sale x JOIN pos_sale_item i ON i.sale_id = x.id WHERE x.store_id = #{storeId} AND x.business_date = #{date} AND x.status = 'COMPLETED'), 0) AS net_sales FROM pos_sale s WHERE s.store_id = #{storeId} AND s.business_date = #{date} AND s.status = 'COMPLETED'

SELECT -SUM(f.cost_amount) FROM pos_sale s JOIN wms_stock_flow f ON f.doc_id = s.wms_doc_id AND f.biz_type IN ('IN', 'OUT') WHERE s.store_id = #{storeId} AND s.business_date = #{date} AND s.status = 'COMPLETED' AND f.cost_amount IS NOT NULL

SELECT g.material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.unit, g.qty, g.amount FROM (SELECT i.material_id, SUM(CASE WHEN s.kind = 'SALE' THEN i.qty ELSE -i.qty END) AS qty, SUM(CASE WHEN s.kind = 'SALE' THEN i.final_amount ELSE -i.final_amount END) AS amount FROM pos_sale s JOIN pos_sale_item i ON i.sale_id = s.id WHERE s.store_id = #{storeId} AND s.business_date = #{date} AND s.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY i.material_id) g JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = g.material_id WHERE g.qty > 0 ORDER BY g.amount DESC, g.qty DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dist_delivery d WHERE d.to_store_id = #{storeId} AND d.status = 'SHIPPED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dist_requisition r WHERE r.store_id = #{storeId} AND r.status = 'DRAFT'
